  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The rate-limit budget handling is reported to risk a numeric-comparison error when `gh api rate_limit` returns a non-numeric value.
  WHY: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro explicitly found the numeric guard and short-circuit sufficient, so the reviewers disagree about whether this is a defect.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:1551-1553 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: First-time log archive fetches are not added to `archive_cache`, so subsequent daily reports fetch the same archives again.
  WHY: The cache is only passed for entries already present, leaving first-time fetches uncached and increasing repeated PAT usage.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:1569-1582 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The report attributes a job’s entire start-to-end quota delta to the UTC hour when the job ended.
  WHY: For jobs spanning multiple hours, this misattributes usage and understates earlier hours in the requested hourly report.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:97-101 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The sweep job is granted broad `actions: write` permission.
  WHY: The permission can manage any workflow or run in the repository, exceeding the minimal scope the reviewer considers necessary.
- tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py:2501-2507 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test’s listing-count assertion is coupled to the current number of `PAT_BUDGET_WORKFLOWS` entries.
  WHY: Adding or removing a workflow can make the assertion fail without clearly explaining the changed expectation.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:136, 206 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The sweep’s rate-limit snapshots use the PAT while two API reads use `github.token`, so the report does not attribute those reads to the PAT.
  WHY: The daily report measures PAT deltas, but the calls using `READ_TOKEN` debit a different rate-limit budget and are therefore omitted from that measurement.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1614-1620 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The workflow hard-codes the requeue label’s color and description instead of using the label contract.
  WHY: A later contract change can leave the workflow’s values stale and cause it to recreate the label with the hard-coded values.
